The old relative258.37m datum remains only in the preserved source master. The broad site ring is contextual; footprint replacement stays off. Anchor 22.873283683,37.891346465; heading -0.026117351143; standard PMTiles datum 510.43219632278726m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

fidelityReview.notes: Approximate current surviving exterior from picture and standard viewer PMTiles. Host supplies the ridge; modern roads, vegetation, fixtures, interiors, buried remains and lost roofs excluded. Physical-device timing unmeasured.
